reading.instructions: Direct original printed JPEG source-first candidate of physical I/77, Arabic printed page 2. Separate left manuscript A and right manuscript B column readings, NOT horizontal interleaving. First A continues Pauline epistles and lists authors/books; B continues New Testament, introduces heading for patristic books and begins long bibliography. Original PDF OCR for this page and same-page peer transcript not viewed. Neighbor images have been seen, so no blind corroboration. Very uncertain archaic glyphs, names and titla, estimated geometry; not verified, no CER. Page 78 continues right column B and has blank left column.
